note: apex311-ea-compat (docs/260 §6): Apex Radiance 3.1.1 vs the v0.2.11 EA app 1.69.47 build, EA laptop, correctness only (game muted, no big CC, no timing). EA mod mode: run with the EA harness queue.ts (branch ea-mod-mode or later), TS3_LAUNCH=ea, TS3_EXE=Sims3Launcher.exe, and TS3_NATIVE_DIR=<v0.2.11 EA build folder> (placeholder: game-copy/ci-ea169-v0211, holding ts3native-ea169.asi + ts3native-ea169-rc.ini + ts3fixes.package from the release/v0.2.11-ea169 CI run); every job's asi is "tested" = that folder. Installs are done by hand between --only runs (docs/260 §6.2): control first with no Apex file in Bin; then the -dxvk jobs with game-copy/apex-3.1.1-eatest/ApexRadiance.asi (Apex 3.1.1 with its process-name check opened, 2 bytes, docs/260 §3.1: the harness game process is Sims3Launcher.exe, which the release asi leaves idle) next to the DXVK d3d9.dll; then the -bridge jobs with the bridge zip unzipped into Bin (DXVK moved out, client.targetProcess set in both bridge.conf files, docs/260 §6.2). Bin backed up whole and hash-checked after; Apex's Documents folder backed up and put back. node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/apex311-ea-compat.json --only <ids> --no-smoke
